metadata.description: Context engineering and agent tooling for Claude Code.

plugins.name: agent-os
plugins.description: A context-engineered agent system for Claude Code: a durable per-project memory layer, a codebase cartographer that remembers what it mapped, and a coordinated agent set that reads your project's rules instead of hardcoding them.

plugins.name: auto-route
plugins.description: Picks the model and effort level for each turn from what the prompt asks for. /route pins a tier or turns routing off.

plugins.name: auto-handoff
plugins.description: Hands a long session off to a fresh one instead of auto-compacting: Haiku writes a structured brief, the mod runs /clear and seeds the new session with it. Vendored from alexknowshtml/claude-auto-handoff (MIT).
